subject: Demo runway sustainment request — procurement delay
messages:
From: Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@medicore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Demo runway sustainment request — procurement delay

Hi Karthik,

Quick note — our pilot with Redwood is scheduled to expire next Wednesday (10/21). Procurement has signaled that our PO process is delayed due to an internal vendor review; legal and finance are still working through the terms. We expect a PO in the next 10 business days but cannot guarantee timing.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short extension or temporary test credits so the engineering team can finish the final validation? Without extra runway we'll lose momentum this week — would prefer 7 calendar days if possible.

I can loop in procurement if that helps. Attached is our internal procurement statement that explains the vendor review (Medicore_procurement_statement.pdf).

Thanks,
Hannah Lowe
Head of Clinical Data Integrations
Medicore Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T11:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo runway sustainment request — procurement delay

Hi Hannah — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the procurement statement.

We can absolutely help avoid the demo interruption. Two options I can offer right away:
- 7-day trial extension (no changes to account, preserves current tokens)
- Immediate 48-hour emergency token grant (to cover a focused testing sprint) while your PO completes

If you need the full week, I can provision a 7-day extension pending final sign-off from our finance team (that's usually a quick internal note). Can you also share the procurement contact or cc procurement@ so we can get a one-line confirmation from them?

I'll loop in Monica from Customer Success to help coordinate the environment during the extension.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_trial_terms.pdf (stub)
From: Procurement Team <procurement@medicore.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@medicore.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T08:47:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo runway sustainment request — procurement delay

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for reaching out. We're aware of the PO delay. We can confirm Medicore's intent to move forward and will issue a PO; current estimate is 7-10 business days due to an external security review. Could Redwood provide a 7-calendar-day extension to preserve the pilot while we finalize paperwork?

If Redwood requires any documentation from procurement to expedite approvals, let us know and we'll provide it. The PO reference (will be added when created) — pref is Medicore-PO-2026-110.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Medicore Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@medicore.com>
Cc: Hannah Lowe <hannah.lowe@medicore.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-21T16:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Demo runway sustainment request — procurement delay

Thanks — appreciate the confirmation. Monica and I have reviewed and we can approve a 7-calendar-day extension effective immediately.

Next steps:
1) We will extend the pilot to 10/28 EOD (7 days) and provision an environment snapshot for your engineering team.
2) Once you have the PO, reply with the PO number and billing contact; we'll mark the deal RDW-2026-1173 as 'PO pending -> Completed' in our system.
3) Monica will send a short checklist to ensure no tokens are wasted during the extended window.

Monica — can you confirm the environment snapshot and share the quick checklist (cc'd). Finance asked we record the extension in HubSpot for audit; the related link is the deal record.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
